remarks: Westport under $1M on a cul-de-sac that is updated, this is the one! In 2016, this home was remodeled from a Cape into a Colonial. Primary bedroom is oversized and boasts a large walk-in closet with built-in's. Bedroom two upstairs is also oversized. Inquire to see if room(s) can be split up since they are large. First floor bedroom option. Kitchen has tremendous storage space with pull-out's, stainless steel undermount farm sink, pot filler at the stove and beverage refrigerator. Two stone patios, garden area and storage shed. Highly desirable Cedar Impressions Vinyl Shingles. Detached one car garage. Seven-minute walk to the train and restaurants @ the train station (approximately 1 mile away), 30 minute walk or 5 minute ride to the beach (1.4 miles) and public pool/golf at Longshore (0.7 miles).

facts.laundryLoc: In Basement and there is a sink adjacent
